newsitem.title: USA: Natgas futures end higher on cold weather prospect.
newsitem.headline: Natgas futures end higher on cold weather prospect.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natgas futures remained near the highs of the day to settle much higher Thursday, supported by forecasts for more cold weather next week and technical shortcovering, sources said.
January finished 33.4 cents higher at $4.409 per mmBtu after reaching a high of $4.46 early in the session. February settled 24.4 cents higher at $3.83, stretching the discount to Jan to 57.9 cents.
"There's a lot of volatility in the market. Every time they sell it off, they buy it right back," one trader said, noting next week's cold forecast is keeping the market strong.
Traders said support in January was around $4.30, then $3.87 and $3.80. Resistance was seen in the $4.56-4.60 area. The contract high is $4.60.
NYMEX said an estimated 45,583 contracts traded, up from Wednesday's revised tally of 44,849. Open interest for December 18 fell 1,432 to 162,081 after hitting a year-high yesterday.
Henry Hub futures expire December 24 at 1300 EST.

In the cash market, Gulf Coast gas prices gained about 20 cents to the $4.60s. Midcontinent prices dropped sharply late, with most deals done in the high-$4.60s, down about five cents. New York city-gate prices were up at least 40 cents to the low-$5 area.
NYMEX January Alberta natgas, which was still untraded, settled 2.5 cents higher at $1.73. Open interest for December 18 fell six to 231.

Physical December prices at the AECO storage hub were also higher in the C$2.14-2.15 per gigajoule range, or mid-$1.60s per mmBtu range. The January market was around C$2.25 per GJ, or $1.77 per mmBtu.
NYMEX January Permian natgas finished untraded at $4.19, up 39 cents. Open interest for December 18 was unchanged at 89.
Physical Permian prices for Friday delivery were talked in the low-$4.80s, mostly unchanged.
On the KCBT, January settled 34.5 cents higher at $4.33. The East/West spread was at 13 cents (NYMEX premium). Open interest for December 18 fell 121 to 2,808.
